ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Ship Shields — Modulated Plasma Fields
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SHIELD_MODS_LEVERAGE_1 — the bespoke building-scale shield comp, ruled owner/2026-09-04 by card (design/Jawa/canon_reintegration_plan.md sec G.9: "bespoke building-scale comp, NOW... the new C# system's maintenance cost accepted"), superseding the earlier survey's lean toward forking a Vanilla Expanded engine (VEF's CompShieldField turned out to be a pawn-apparel comp, not building-scale; see the item file's source-verification section).
One `RUT_ShieldGenerator` building, one field active at a time, switched by installing a module (shd:loadout-tradeoff) rather than four separate buildings:
- Bubble/kinetic (shd:bubble-not-wall, default, no module needed): a real subclass of vanilla's own `CompProjectileInterceptor` (the same base class Odyssey's native gravship shield generator uses, RimWorld/CompGravshipShieldGenerator.cs) rather than a fork of any mod's engine. Forcibly draining it to 0 hit points triggers a collapse explosion (shd:bubble-not-wall's "prone to overheating or even explosion when forcibly collapsed"). - Thermal veil (shd:thermal-veil, module-gated): partially rejects outdoor temperature drift via `GenTemperature.ControlTemperatureTempChange` + `PushHeat` (the same primitives vanilla heaters/coolers use), power-only, never a full cancellation — the room still climbs toward extremes, just far more slowly. - Particulate screen (shd:particulate-screen, module-gated): v1 slice only clears weather-deposited filth in radius each interval. Small-animal repulsion and direct weather-damage negation are NOT yet implemented — see the item file's remaining-gap note.
Canon-wide "slow-moving things pass through every shield" (shd:shield- collapse-evacuate) is implemented as a Harmony prefix on `CompProjectileInterceptor.CheckIntercept`, scoped to this mod's own `CompShieldGenerator` only — vanilla's native gravship/mech shields are left untouched pending a separate, larger call on whether to extend it further.
Predictive shield-failure alerts (shd:shield-collapse-evacuate's evacuation warning) and the landing-hazard advisory (shd:no-hard-landing-gate) are explicitly OUT of this build — they are separate mechanisms, not part of the shield generator's own comp, and remain open work.
Full spec: design/Jawa/proposals/ship_shields_deep_design.md. Survey and scoping history: infrastructure/state/items/SHIELD_MODS_LEVERAGE_1.md, research/Jawa/shield_mods_survey_2026-09-02.md.
